name: AI JobSnap
description: Smart Career Copilot with multi-source job scraping, resume-aware matching, outreach, and learning roadmaps.

RUN_CELERY_IN_WEB.description: Set to false to run background jobs in lightweight threads inside Gunicorn and save memory on 512MB dynos.

FORCE_LOCAL_THREAD_TASKS.description: Set to true when no Redis broker is attached so tasks run in local background threads.

MAINTENANCE_MODE.description: Set to true to return HTTP 503 with the maintenance page.
